title: Ideal-Aura Topological Spaces, New Local Functions, and Generalized Open Sets
summary: We combine an ideal topological space $(X, τ, \mathcal{I})$ with a scope function $\mathfrak{a}: X \to τ$, $x \in \mathfrak{a}(x)$, to form what we call an ideal-aura topological space $(X, τ, \mathcal{I}, \mathfrak{a})$. The central new object is the aura-local function $A^{\mathfrak{a}}(\mathcal{I}) = \{x \in X : \mathfrak{a}(x) \cap A \notin \mathcal{I}\}$, which extends the Jankovic-Hamlett local function: we always have $A^{*}(\mathcal{I}, τ) \subseteq A^{\mathfrak{a}}(\mathcal{I})$.
